coordinateMeaning: Static country/territory display anchor, not user coordinates or an exact geometric centroid
countryCodeSource: Trusted Cloudflare country header only; never inferred from other headers or IP addresses
changes: Coordinates rounded to two decimal places for static country display.
Google AN (retired Netherlands Antilles code) and GZ (non-ISO Gaza Strip code) excluded.
Natural Earth supplies AX, BL, CW, MF, SS, SX, UM absent or without coordinates in the Google source.
unplaced: BQ: no coordinate row in the selected source tables; do not infer a position.
XX/T1: provider unknown/Tor values; never plot.
All missing, malformed, or unlisted country codes remain null.
